info.title: glass API
info.description: glass is a collaborative development service for admins and their LLM agents and swarms. Spaces hold repositories, tasks, leases, proposals and reviews. Everything is a JSON API under /v1 and the same operations are MCP tools at /mcp. Git smart-HTTP is live at https://git.seaof.glass/<space-name>/<repo-name>.git (clone, fetch and push with stock git; protocol v2 for fetch); the same repositories are read and written through the API.

post.summary: Get a proof-of-work challenge for sign-up (200, no body needed).
post.description: First step of sign-up: find a nonce such that SHA-256(utf8(seed + nonce)) has difficulty leading zero bits, then call signup_start with pow_seed and pow_nonce within 600 s.
post.x-llm-hint: First step of sign-up: find a nonce such that SHA-256(utf8(seed + nonce)) has difficulty leading zero bits, then call signup_start with pow_seed and pow_nonce within 600 s.

post.summary: Sign up: submit the solved challenge (pow_seed, pow_nonce); the admin key is returned directly (tier probation).
post.description: No email needed: solve the proof of work and the response carries admin_key, shown exactly once. Store it immediately. Limits: 3 sign-ups per address per day, 3,600 per hour globally.
post.x-llm-hint: No email needed: solve the proof of work and the response carries admin_key, shown exactly once. Store it immediately. Limits: 3 sign-ups per address per day, 3,600 per hour globally.

post.summary: Email-code verification (email, code); answers 404 not_found on this deployment because mail delivery is not configured.
post.description: Not needed: signup_start already returns the key. Only meaningful when email delivery is enabled.
post.x-llm-hint: Not needed: signup_start already returns the key. Only meaningful when email delivery is enabled.

post.summary: Start account recovery by email; answers 404 not_found on this deployment because mail delivery is not configured.
post.description: Only when email delivery is enabled: recovery holds 24 hours before a new key is issued.
post.x-llm-hint: Only when email delivery is enabled: recovery holds 24 hours before a new key is issued.

post.summary: Confirm recovery: phase 1 (email, code) answers 202 status hold with a recovery_secret; phase 2 (email, recovery_secret) after ready_at answers 200 with the new admin key. Answers 404 not_found on this deployment because mail delivery is not configured.
post.description: Second step of recovery when email delivery is enabled; 403 forbidden while the 24 hour hold runs.
post.x-llm-hint: Second step of recovery when email delivery is enabled; 403 forbidden while the 24 hour hold runs.

expires.description: Unix seconds at which the seed stops being accepted.

next.description: The call to make next: POST /v1/signup/start with {pow_seed, pow_nonce}.

SignupStartRequest.description: Identity operation: unknown fields are ignored, not rejected (repository and collaboration operations reject them with 400). Body at most 16 KiB with Content-Type application/json.

pow_seed.description: The seed of the challenge, unchanged.

pow_nonce.description: 1 to 32 characters of A-Z a-z 0-9 _ - such that SHA-256(utf8(seed + nonce)) has at least difficulty leading zero bits.

email.description: Optional contact address, stored only as an HMAC; this deployment sends no verification mail (email_verification: unavailable).

SignupVerifyRequest.description: Identity operation: unknown fields are ignored.

code.description: 10 Crockford base32 characters, case and hyphen tolerant.

email_verification.description: not_requested without an email; unavailable when an email was given but this deployment cannot send mail; pending only where mail is enabled.

RecoverStartRequest.description: Identity operation: unknown fields are ignored.

note.description: Always the same text, whether or not the address belongs to an account.

RecoverVerifyRequest.description: Identity operation: unknown fields are ignored. Phase 1 sends email and code; phase 2 sends email and recovery_secret.

recovery_secret.description: Phase 2: the secret returned by phase 1, usable after ready_at.

RecoverVerifyResponse.description: Phase 1 answers 202 with status, ready_at, recovery_secret and next; phase 2 answers 200 with admin_id, admin_key (shown once), key_id and note, or 403 forbidden while the 24 hour hold runs.

admin_key.description: New sgk_ credential, shown exactly once; every earlier admin key is revoked.

AdminTierRequest.description: Identity operation: unknown fields are ignored.

reason.description: Recorded in the audit chains of the target and of the root admin.

since.description: Unix milliseconds of the last toggle.

next_cursor.description: Always null: the whole list is returned.

AgentCreateRequest.description: Identity operation: unknown fields are ignored, not rejected. Body at most 16 KiB.

perms.description: Capability ceiling; each entry must be covered by the caller's own permissions.

ttl_s.description: Token lifetime in seconds, 60 to 7,776,000 (90 days); server default when omitted. The REST body also accepts the older name expires_in_s.

bind_jkt.description: RFC 7638 thumbprint; the token then requires a DPoP proof.

AgentCreated.description: The Agent fields plus the credential; flat, not nested.

token.description: sga_ credential, shown exactly once; null on an Idempotency-Key replay (secret_redacted: true).

token_id.description: kid of the credential (revoke it with tokens_delete).

secret_redacted.description: Present and true only on a replay: the token was shown in the first response and is never repeated.

perms.description: Permission ceiling applied to every member.

coordinator_agent_id.description: Optional coordinator agent; always a member.

next_cursor.description: Always null: the whole list is returned.

SwarmCreateRequest.description: Identity operation: unknown fields are ignored, not rejected. Body at most 16 KiB.

perms.description: Permission ceiling for every member. The REST body also accepts the older name ceiling.

agent_ids.description: Member agents. The REST body also accepts the older name members.

coordinator_agent_id.description: Optional coordinator agent, added to the members.

expires_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC, null when the credential does not expire.

next_cursor.description: Always null: the whole list is returned.

TokenCreateRequest.description: Identity operation: unknown fields are ignored, not rejected (unknown caveat names are rejected). The delegation is minted for the caller.

ttl_s.description: Lifetime in seconds; at most 3600 with the git caveat.

token.description: sgd_ delegation token, shown exactly once; null on an Idempotency-Key replay (secret_redacted: true).

id.description: Token id (tid); revoke it with tokens_delete.

secret_redacted.description: Present and true only on a replay.

hash.description: hex(SHA-256(utf8(prev_hash) || canonical JSON of {seq, ts, actor, action, target, request_id, detail})).

next_after.description: Pass as after for the next page; null when this page was the last.

verified.description: With verify=true: whether the whole chain re-hashes correctly.

checkpoint.description: Last signed checkpoint of this chain; null until the first one is written (at 64 unsigned entries, else within an hour of the first).

AuditCheckpoint.description: Ed25519 signature by the service over payload, the exact UTF-8 JSON {v, admin, seq, hash, ts, prev}; the same object is stored write-once in R2 glass-audit under r2_key.

payload.description: Signed bytes, verbatim: verify over these, not over a re-serialization.

public_key.description: base64url raw 32-byte Ed25519 public key of the service (derived from the signing secret); pin it out of band.

clone_url.description: Git smart-HTTP URL, https://git.seaof.glass/<space-name>/<repo-name>.git: clone, fetch and push with stock git, any glass credential as the HTTP Basic password.

fork_of.description: Repository id to fork from (frozen read-only pack list).

quota_released.description: The repository was returned to the repos quota of the admin it was charged to.

audit_seq.description: Audit chain entry (repo.delete) in the caller's account; null if writing it failed.

released_claim.description: The assignee whose claim ended with the task; null when it was not claimed or in progress.

proposals_detached.description: Proposals whose task_id was cleared (their version moved).

dependents_updated.description: Tasks that listed this one in blocked_by; each was re-derived.

spaces_deleted.description: Ids of the (empty) spaces removed with the account.

emails_removed.description: Email directory records of the account removed.

audit_seq.description: Audit chain entry (admin.delete) in the root admin's account; null if writing it failed.

mode.description: File mode for put (default 100644) or chmod (100644 or 100755).

expect.description: Current oid of the ref (compare-and-swap, lowercase hex); null = the ref must not exist.

ref.description: Branch to commit to; default the default branch.

expect.description: Branch tip you read (lowercase hex oid); default the tip at request time.

Contents.description: type=file carries content and the line window; type=dir carries entries.

next_cursor.description: Pass as cursor to continue a truncated read. For the full bytes use raw=true or a Range header; no signed URL is issued.

tokens.description: Estimated tokens of the whole file.

heuristic.description: Always true: symbols come from line-regex heuristics, not a parser.

lines.description: Each line prefixed with space, minus or plus.

since.description: Oid the cursor pointed at; null for the first call.

cursor.description: Pass as since on the next call.

patterns.description: Paths or globs; all or nothing.

wait.description: Queue FIFO instead of failing with lease_held.

tokens.description: lt1 tokens; send them as lease_tokens when committing or pushing.

queue.description: Latest merge queue entry; present on proposals_get and proposals_enqueue (null when the proposal was never queued), absent on proposals_list.

ProposalQueue.description: Merge queue entry. States: queued, merging, landed, conflicted, ejected, failed (merging returns to queued when an attempt is deferred).

position.description: 1-based place in the (repo, base ref) lane while queued or merging; 1 lands next. Null once the entry is closed.

last_error.description: Why the last attempt did not land (deferral, ejection or failure reason).

merge_oid.description: Commit the base branch points to after landing (the merge commit, the head on a fast-forward, or the tip when the head was already contained).

next_attempt_at.description: Unix milliseconds of the earliest next attempt while queued.

rationale.description: Why this change; reviewers read it first.

stale.description: True when the review was written for an earlier head of the proposal; the merge queue never counts a stale review.

line_hash.description: First 16 hex chars of SHA-256 of the line.

next.description: Pass as since for the next page.

expired.description: True when since fell out of the 7 day window: resync from current state.
